description: Plugin-fixed start procedure (design §3.1). analyze → ac-format → plan. Not a template: evolve never changes it. In stage 1 the plan step is the I1 machine rule (acparse.plan_rule_stop): type != feature, a split proposal, an open prerequisite or risk high stop for a human; otherwise the engine posts the assumptions and goes on. From stage 2 it is the leader's plan gate (tasks/plan-gate.md): risk high still goes to a human (scope D4, conservative); the engine writes the template steps after the leader's plan answer.
